question: According to Piaget's stages of moral judgment, a child younger than age ten will think which of the following is worse? A. Someone who was trying to help his mother set the table and broke five dishes. B. Someone who was stealing a cookie from the cookie jar when he wasn't allowed, and knocked over a cup that broke. C. Someone who did not control the dog who jumped up on the table and pulled down a glass full of water, which broke. D. Someone who accidentally dropped a dinner knife which could have hurt someone if they would have stepped on it.
